description: The change feed of the rules dataset: every parameter, form and deadline change (new tax brackets, minimum wage updates, new form editions, published deadline tables), newest detected first, with effective date, detected date and sources.

effective_from.description: Only changes that take effect on or after this date (e.g. "2026-01-01" for this year)

effective_to.description: Only changes that take effect on or before this date

include_backfill.description: Include history that was in the dataset when the feed started

include_notices.description: Include notices that a verified period ends (no new law)

since.description: Only changes detected on or after this date

target.description: Only targets starting with this (e.g. "btl." or "101")

name: list_changes
title: List changes to Israeli rules
